observations.observation: Kelp is upward-growing head plus body, both intrinsically WATER source states, liquid-container insert APIs false; attachment rejects MAGMA then requires head/body or sturdy upper support. No generic waterlogged boolean/ambientfluid restoration equivalence.

Manual Kelp placement requires current fluid taggedWATER amount8; natural and canGrowInto instead require exact Blocks.WATER, no own sourceamount8 check there. Sourceplacement and fluidtag habitat are not interchangeable predicates.

Head AGE0..25, placed head uses randomnextInt25 (0..24); randomly ticking only AGE<25. Natural attempt randomdef .14 passed to Forge pre, which ALLOW overrides defaultfalse but does not bypass outer AGE gate or targetexactWATER gate; DEFAULT usesdef, DENY false.

Head above head/body converts to default body through updateShape; loss of lower support schedules one-tick survival destroyBlock(true). Fluidticks scheduled on other branch; no own NBT escrow/success return certification.

When body loses matching head/body immediatelyabove, converts to head.getStateForPlacement(level), giving fresh0..24 age; harvest/replacement of old head can restart natural-growth age. AGE cap is not absolute column height/finite lifetime budget.

Body bonemeal helper walks matching body blocks in growthdirection until first different block then only accepts head; no own fixed distance cap. Validation and perform separately rescan, may change between calls; no cachedstable head receipt.

Head bonemeal validity only target canGrowInto, no AGE<25 gate; success always true, perform requests exactly one Kelp growth and clamps new age min(age+1,25). A max-age head can be bonemealed repeatedly into exact WATER, each new head stays25; natural ageing vs paid growth separate.

Bonemeal writes ignore setBlockAndUpdate return and no own nutrientcounter in Kelp classes. Real payment and mode/Forgeevent behavior require old complete BoneMealItem/BonemealEvent/Factory source, not performBonemeal void alone; no claim actualmodpack paid outcome.
